text_block_list.text:
After wrapping up some errands with
Fuji Kiseki,
we start heading home.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, can you come with me
somewhere after
this?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I knew you'd say yes!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And thank goodness because I've
already
reserved seats for us. ♪ Come
on!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, you'll see soon enough. Just
leave
everything to me.

I have no choice but to follow her as she
brings
me to the planetarium.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Shhh, just relax. The show's about to
begin.

I rest on the reclining seat, and before I
know it,
we're drifting along a sea of
stars.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Did you have fun today? I like the
concerts we
put on, but it's nice to
watch the stars dance once
in a while
too, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It was cute how the stars of the Big
Dipper
seemed to dance around. It made
it look like Ursa
Major itself was
dancing! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Spica is so gorgeous and mysterious,
and... well, I
think its sparkle is just like
the twinkle in your
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Because I wanted to give you
some time to
relax.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You always work so hard to show me
that I burn
just as brightly as any star in
the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So, as thanks, I wanted to show you stars
too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Every distant twinkling star in the vast
velvet
stretch above us represents a
fraction of the
gratitude I feel for you
every day. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. From here onward, let me be
your guide
to the rest of your dreams.
choice_data_list: So that's what was going on...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a miracle even to those
closest to
me. So tell me... what kind of
surprise would you
like next?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a miracle even to those
closest to
me. So tell me... what kind of
surprise would you
like next?
choice_data_list: Next time, let's go stargazing for real.
Anything's special as long as we're together.
Everything is special when we're together.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Real stars, eh? So you want to travel into
space
with me next, do you?
choice_data_list: Next time, let's go stargazing for real.
Anything's special as long as we're together.
Everything is special when we're together.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Never mind simple race tours—I'd
love to
go on a never-ending journey to
the far reaches
of the Milky Way with
you.
choice_data_list: It's not that big of a deal...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it would be delightful to talk
about this
and that while weaving
through constellations.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll go anywhere you wish when the time
comes.
It's a promise, my dear
Campanella. ♪

Gazing at the stars is certainly calming,
but her
sweet words are more soothing
than anything in
the world.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha... You can be kind of scary
sometimes, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you were able to pull off
such a
smooth line despite never having
studied theater.
You're something else.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then again... you and I are both
entertainers, so
perhaps it's good that
we can surprise one
another.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep dancing this never-ending
waltz
together, you and I, while sharing
our dreams.
...Did you like that one?
Hehe. ♪

There many be innumerable stars in the
sky, but I
have the feeling the brightest
star of all is the one
standing right
beside me.
